e.title: ERM159 Image Recognition for Insurance (SOA)
e.summary: SOA 官方研究《Image Recognition for Insurance》：PyTorch 图像识别教育程序
e.body: ERM159 是 SOA 研究学会《Image Recognition for Insurance》研究项目的官方代码：一个简洁的 PyTorch 图像识别程序，帮助读者快速理解深度学习图像识别——用于理赔图片（车损照片、财产损失照片）自动评估、欺诈检测等保险场景。教育导向（Python3.5/PyTorch）。对 RIAA：保险图像识别入门的官方教材，与 [[ins-mmbench]]（保险多模态基准）的视觉侧呼应。关联 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-ai-case-studies]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：SOA Research Institute 官方项目 ERM159，PyTorch 图像识别教育程序（理赔图片/保险场景），Python3.5+PyTorch
e.summary_en: Official SOA research 'Image Recognition for Insurance': a concise PyTorch image-recognition educational program
e.summary_hk: SOA 官方研究《Image Recognition for Insurance》：PyTorch 圖像識別教育程序
e.body_en: ERM159 is the official code of the SOA Research Institute's 'Image Recognition for Insurance' project: a concise PyTorch image-recognition program to help readers quickly understand deep-learning image recognition — for insurance scenarios such as automated assessment of claim photos (vehicle damage, property loss) and fraud detection. Education-oriented (Python3.5/PyTorch). For RIAA: official teaching material for insurance image recognition, echoing the vision side of [[ins-mmbench]] (insurance multimodal benchmark). Related: [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[actuarial-ai-case-studies]].
e.body_hk: ERM159 是 SOA 研究學會《Image Recognition for Insurance》研究項目的官方代碼：一個簡潔的 PyTorch 圖像識別程序，幫助讀者快速理解深度學習圖像識別——用於理賠圖片（車損照片、財產損失照片）自動評估、欺詐檢測等保險場景。教育導向（Python3.5/PyTorch）。對 RIAA：保險圖像識別入門的官方教材，與 [[ins-mmbench]]（保險多模態基準）的視覺側呼應。關聯 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-ai-case-studies]]。
